workbench.title: Your match plan
workbench.subtitle: Compare alternatives, refine the orders and save your match plan.
workbench.storageFailed: Plan available for this session only — browser storage failed.
workbench.restoredStale: Data or requirements have changed. Recalculate before saving or sending.
workbench.forecastSaved: Forecast saved for review after the match.
workbench.forecastIncomplete: The forecast needs more context. Complete:
workbench.forecastFailed: Plan saved, but forecast capture failed:
workbench.trainingAssumption: Training comparison assumes 90 minutes for each selected trainee without substitutions. This is this match's contribution, not the weekly total. — means an unquantified effect.
workbench.unchanged: This is the suggested lineup. Change a player or select another formation to compare the effect.
workbench.comparisonHint: The table shows sector gains and losses relative to the initial suggestion. Differences are model estimates.
workbench.scenarioHint: Sensitivity test changes opponent ratings by ±15%. These are assumed scenarios, not confidence intervals or a prediction of their tactic.
workbench.dirty: The lineup has changed. Recalculate to update the comparison.
workbench.subHint: Substitutions keep the outgoing player's position and behaviour. Conditional substitutions do not guarantee training minutes.
workbench.confirmHint: Sending will replace orders for this match. Check the bench, substitutions and penalty takers too.
workbench.demoNoSend: Sending match orders is disabled in demo mode.
workbench.contextHint: Values come from team data; you can adjust them before calculating. An empty field means no manual override.
workbench.storageWarning: The result could not be saved to browser storage.
workbench.trainingDraft: The training plan date does not match an upcoming fixture. You can compare a lineup, but sending is disabled. Select the correct match above.
